scripts.predeploy:
node -e "if (!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN) { console.error('
❌  NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN is not set.
    The map will be broken in the deployed build.
    Set it in .env.local and re-run: NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN=$(grep NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN .env.local | cut -d= -f2) npm run build
'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.deploy: npx wrangler deploy && npm run verify-deploy
